question:
The pie chart given below shows the number of girls in six schools P, Q, R, S, T and U. The total number of girls in all these six schools are 3000. Number of girls in a particular school is shown as a percentage of total number of girls in all these six schools. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f287d7372e9ca6d1656b663fa73d549a46250e20e335451d4d8c1f041a9e9e6.png] 

What is the total number of girls in schools P and R?
solution:
Calculation:

Now, the total number of girls in school P and R

⇒ 3000 × (17 + 31)%

⇒ 1440

**∴ The total number of girls in school P and R is 1440.**
